Поставив Леонсию позади себя, так что её рука цеплялась за полу его куртки, чтобы он мог её вести, он двинулся вперёд, касаясь левой рукой стены. Вровень с ним Торрес пробирался на ощупь вдоль правой стены. По голосам они могли следить друг за другом, измерять ширину прохода и не опасаться, что их разлучат разветвления. К счастью, туннель, а это был настоящий туннель, имел гладкий пол, так что, хотя они двигались на ощупь, они не спотыкались. Фрэнсис отказался жечь спички, пока не возникнет крайняя нужда, и, опасаясь упасть в возможную яму, осторожно выдвигал вперёд по одной ноге и убеждался, что под ней прочный камень, прежде чем перенести на неё вес. Поэтому продвигались они медленно. Они шли со скоростью не более полумили в час.", "source_sha256": "160ab7aa3c3fc5e74ffa752390898692186718f1b7d0c9fc0b6c407fcde965fd", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u018-r0047", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "c7efa430d1473f32c8f65b7bce53faed446890f8e5f2f37a6a65a837c7099655"}]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "ru78-u018-r0048", "tag": "p", "text": "Once only did they encounter branching passages. Once only did they encounter branching passages. Here he lighted a precious match from his waterproof case, and found that between the two passages there was nothing to choose. They were as like as two peas.

There’s one thing certain: these passages lead somewhere, or the Mayas wouldn’t have gone to all the trouble of making them.”", "sha256": "dd97775d4cb15d4e4987a5176dd36183e074be2c88b0cf7af7434d127c203597", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1503]", "source_html": "

The foot he had advanced was suspended in emptiness where the floor should have been. Another match was struck, and they found themselves on the edge of a natural cavern of such proportions that neither to right nor left, nor up nor down, nor across, could the tiny flame expose any limits to it. But they did manage to make out a rough sort of stairway, half-natural, half-improved by man, which fell away beneath them into the pit of black.", "sha256": "9ce11aee09e5cca477898276c0d6a0c849f064ed74ad7b76fc1a41d23cb3c222", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1504]", "source_html": "

Ten minutes later he halted suddenly and cried warning. The foot he had advanced was suspended in emptiness where the floor should have been. Another match was struck, and they found themselves on the edge of a natural cavern of such proportions that neither to right nor left, nor up nor down, nor across, could the tiny flame expose any limits to it. But they did manage to make out a rough sort of stairway, half-natural, half-improved by man, which fell away beneath them into the pit of black.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u018-r0051", "tag": "p", "text": "In another hour, having followed the path down the length of the floor of the cavern, they were rewarded by a feeble glimmer of daylight, which grew stronger as they advanced. Before they knew it, they had come to the source of it——being much nearer than they had judged; and Francis, tearing away vines and shrubbery, crawled out into the blaze of the afternoon sun. In a moment Leoncia and Torres were beside him, gazing down into a valley from an eyrie on a cliff. Nearly circular was the valley, a full league in diameter, and it appeared to be mountain-walled and cliff-walled for its entire circumference.", "sha256": "2f40c0fb8b6de9dca70fa4df9274e260d8ae19754a286b6504ea8c6b06410bf0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1505]", "source_html": "

In another hour, having followed the path down the length of the floor of the cavern, they were rewarded by a feeble glimmer of daylight, which grew stronger as they advanced. Before they knew it, they had come to the source of it——being much nearer than they had judged; and Francis, tearing away vines and shrubbery, crawled out into the blaze of the afternoon sun. In a moment Leoncia and Torres were beside him, gazing down into a valley from an eyrie on a cliff. Nearly circular was the valley, a full league in diameter, and it appeared to be mountain-walled and cliff-walled for its entire circumference.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u018-r0053", "tag": "p", "text": "“So have I heard of it and never believed,” Leoncia gasped.", "sha256": "e4cc740b893d9d15d5ef5d7f4b8c9134b97f3505cd8fe939a6d1f2b9f7ef3e94", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1507]", "source_html": "

“So have I heard of it and never believed,” Leoncia gasped.

“Then how do you know that anybody got in?” Francis persisted.
